The Big Story · Cybersecurity

The trains were not hacked. So why were 7.39 million addresses at risk?

One ransomware attack reached JR East, Viewcard and JR Kyushu through a company most passengers never knew was there. The number is a maximum, not a confirmed theft—but the hidden dependency is real.

Japanese word of the day委託先 · itakusaki

Itakusaki means a contractor or service provider entrusted with work. 委託 means “entrustment” or “commissioning”; 先 identifies the receiving party. It appears often in official incident notices: 委託先のシステム means “the contractor’s system.” Today’s rail story is about the itakusaki passengers never saw.
